## Swirly Cotton

Swirly Cotton is a one-scene background Earth pony mare in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. Look for her among Ponyville's singers in **“Winter Wrap Up” (season 1, episode 11)**. She has a light lavender coat, pale pink-lilac mane and tail, and bright green eyes; her familiar silhouette resembles Golden Harvest and Daisy.

“Swirly Cotton” is a community/catalog identifier, **not a name spoken in the show**. Its original coiner is not established, and I found no confirmed official naming credit, secret identity, or alternate persona. She is shown singing with the group, but has no verified individual dialogue or credited voice actor. No other TV, film, or comic appearance could be confirmed.

## Important moments

- **Joining the Winter Wrap Up chorus — “Winter Wrap Up” (S1E11).** Swirly Cotton sings with Ponyville's residents as they work together to welcome spring. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zoOO4y81bvQ) (scene timestamp unavailable; not independently verified in this upload).

This is her only specifically documented scene; adding more “important moments” would mistake unrelated background ponies for her.
